key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual psychiatric encounter benchmark that tests whether LLMs can handle the full S.O.A.P. clinical workflow, not just isolated tasks.
clinical_relevance: It offers a more realistic way to evaluate and compare AI support for psychiatric interviewing, assessment, documentation, and treatment planning.
method: Built skill-augmented standardized patients from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases across major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders
Ran dual-track scoring with objective comparison to EHR references plus subjective clinical-process assessment
Created MentalEval, five domain-specific evaluators for empathy, professionalism, note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness
evidence_signal: The benchmark was supported by 22 clinicians, MentalEval reached an average QWK of 0.944, and the strongest LLM still lagged clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence.
watch_item: Because the system relies on simulated encounters and automated evaluators, real-world clinical use should be validated carefully before any deployment.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
